Select exact IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join docs on activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id and doi; prefer pubmed_id when both are present. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5251' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and activities.standard_relation = '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
